facts.claim_en: In Michigan, creditors generally must present claims within 4 months after the notice to creditors is published.
facts.claim_es: En Míchigan, los acreedores normalmente deben presentar sus reclamos dentro de 4 meses después de publicado el aviso.
facts.quote: Within 4 months after the date of the publication of notice to creditors.

facts.claim_en: In Michigan, a creditor the personal representative learns of late gets 28 days from when the representative first knows of them.
facts.claim_es: En Míchigan, un acreedor del que el representante personal se entera tarde tiene 28 días desde que el representante lo conoce.
facts.quote: within 28 days after the personal representative first knows of the creditor

facts.claim_en: In Michigan, if the notice to creditors was not properly given, claims can be presented up to 3 years after the death.
facts.claim_es: En Míchigan, si no se dio bien el aviso a los acreedores, los reclamos se pueden presentar hasta 3 años después de la muerte.
facts.quote: If the notice requirements of section 3801 or 7608 have not been met, within 3 years after the decedent's death.
